_doc: IFDO-CHATBOX crisis screen, ONE source (spec r4 F5). Site copy src/lib/crisis-terms.json must be byte-identical (sha256 parity contract). Match (U7 normalise spec): NFKC, lower, drop zero-width/soft chars, non [a-z0-9] -> space, collapse; spaced form at word boundaries, or the joined (spaces removed) form as a substring when it is 8+ chars; a trailing * is a prefix (no right boundary; joined form is a plain substring). Screens the current plus the previous visitor turn. Tier A stops the case; tier B shows the 911/988 line and continues (F6).
